svg.text: A, B = discs soaked in two plant extracts
C = control discs (solvent only, e.g. ethanol, evaporated)
Measure the diameter across two directions at right
angles and take the mean (red lines on zone A)
Area of zone = πr², where r = mean diameter ÷ 2
(if concentration and diffusion are the same)
Lawn of bacteria spread evenly over the agar
Quarters marked on the BASE of the dish
Lid taped at two points (not sealed); dish inverted;
